# Reprojection focus, pointer order and invalid drafts in grid editing

## Context

Leaf of #18762, slice 2 (interaction contract). The slice's remaining terminals: where focus goes on reprojection, the order of events when the pointer activates a cell, and what an invalid draft does.

| terminal | state today |
|---|---|
| focus on reprojection | **red**, measured by @neo-fable in #18843: a record sorted or filtered out of the row pool and back reprojects with its draft, but focus is on `grid.View`, not the editor |
| pointer ordering | the simple case works (the #18762 evaluation round: a click on another cell commits, then selects it). The plugin does not consume `GestureClaimArbiter`, which D#17832 names as the ordering primitive |
| invalid draft | unmeasured |
| double-click activation | measured by @neo-fable after filing: the two clicks toggle the `CellModel` selection on and off (no selected cell, and no selected row under the row models), so after the commit focus is on `grid.View` with no anchor cell for the arrow keys. Enter and F2 activation keep the selection |

## The Problem

D#17832 OQ5 settled them:
- DOM focus returns on reprojection only while the session's generation still owns it.
- Activating another cell first resolves the current session's terminal, then processes the new target, through `GestureClaimArbiter` rather than a second gesture-claim protocol.
- An invalid draft stays: no leave-edit gesture ends it.

## The Architectural Reality

- The session is `{recordId, dataField, editor}` (`src/grid/plugin/CellEditing.mjs`). Reprojection is the next Row render of the proving cell, and `isEmbodied` reads the row pool and the column window.
- `src/manager/GestureClaimArbiter.mjs` is the engine's per-gesture claim arbiter.
- #18843's store driver moves a record out of the pool and back without taking focus. Its recipe is reusable here.

## The Fix

- On reprojection, focus the editor when focus was in it at suspension and no newer intent has moved it.
- Route the pointer's activate-another-cell sequence through `GestureClaimArbiter`, or record in the PR why the current order is already the arbiter's.
- Witness the invalid-draft terminal. Fix it if it does not hold.

## Acceptance Criteria

> **Split 2026-09-18 (author):** the reprojection-focus and click-away-order ACs moved, word for word, to #18927. PR #18912 delivers the two below, so it resolves this ticket as narrowed. Same shape as #18861 / #18883.

- [ ] After a double-click edit commits, the edited cell is selected, so the arrow keys have an anchor.
- [ ] An invalid draft keeps the editor through Enter, Tab, a click away and focus leaving the grid.
- [ ] Each arm is killed by a named mutation recorded in the PR.

## Out of Scope

- Tab traversal and select-on-activation (the leaves beside this one).
- The picker island (#18838).
- A removed record ending the session at removal (noted in #18843, undecided).
